scope: Real16-track preparation grows Wasm. At committed selected-video fragment boundary retain MSE and build an offset-preserving selected-track-only Blob view (unused trak boxes become free). Fresh maintained native worker resumes from explicit next-sample recipe; verify config, packet hashes and DTS before append/old-worker retirement. No opaque pointer/heap export.
gate: Same MediaSource, SourceBuffer and video URL, no waiting while handoff plays, full independent native picture queries and all next-fragment packets exact; stale recipe and corrupt output rejected. Steady reserved Wasm capacity reduction>=10%, overlap<=2x old capacity. Cold preparation time, reads and JS header allocation reported, not speed or RSS improvement.
excluded: Video-only all-intra profile, selected track0 and stable original File authority. Audio/subtitles, B-frame restoration and arbitrary dynamic track selection are not qualified.
